changes: Replaced placeholder instructions with a complete adult portrait direction, removed the named van, all stickers, and the custom-text sign, and changed sleepwear to covered streetwear.

project_info.theme: adult retro-van analog flash street portrait
project_info.color_palette: faded navy, black, cream, asphalt gray, flash white, and warm streetlamp amber

main_subject.description: An adult woman with black windblown hair, light natural makeup, visible lashes, and a calm confident expression.
main_subject.wardrobe: Cream utility overshirt buttoned over a black T-shirt, relaxed charcoal trousers, and black leather boots.
main_subject.pose: Candid half-squat beside the rear quarter of a worn retro van, one hand resting lightly on a blank unmarked board, the other relaxed on the knee.

composition_elements.framing: Vertical full-body night portrait with the van extending through the right side of the frame.
composition_elements.environment: Quiet urban asphalt street, distant buildings, a faded navy unbranded retro van with plain windows, and a blank board with no writing or symbols.

lighting_and_atmosphere.lighting: Single analog 35mm flash, sharp subject exposure, darker underexposed background, and gentle wind movement in hair.
lighting_and_atmosphere.atmosphere: Authentic, rough, nostalgic, and quietly self-assured.

technical_specs.quality: rough paper grain, faint scratches, realistic flash falloff, unretouched skin, no digital-clean finish

prompt.generated_prompt_string: Create a photoreal vertical 35mm analog-flash street portrait of an adult woman beside a faded navy unbranded retro van at night. She has black windblown hair, light natural makeup, visible lashes, and a calm confident expression. She wears a cream utility overshirt buttoned over a black T-shirt, relaxed charcoal trousers, and black leather boots. Pose her in a candid half-squat by the rear quarter of the van, one hand resting on a blank unmarked board and the other on her knee. Show a quiet asphalt street and distant buildings. Use one analog flash, sharp subject exposure, a darker underexposed background, rough paper grain, faint scratches, realistic flash falloff, and no stickers, logos, text, or symbols.
prompt.negative_prompt: minor, sleepwear, pajama set, named vehicle, VW, Combi, sticker, readable board text, logo, watermark, digital-clean image, bright background, nudity, explicit, nsfw, overly revealing clothing, distorted anatomy

reference_elements.prompt_instructions: All references are optional. Use them only to replace adult wardrobe, van silhouette, or analog texture; remove all text, stickers, logos, and labels.
